title: Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper input

domains.title: Website domains
domains.description: Look up every advertiser running ads for these domains, in bulk (for example nike.com).

advertiserIds.title: Advertiser IDs
advertiserIds.description: Transparency Center advertiser IDs, for example AR16735076323512287233 (shown in the advertiser's page URL).

searchTerms.title: Advertiser names
searchTerms.description: Advertiser names to search, for example nike. Google suggests several advertisers per name; every candidate is scored (1 means the name matches exactly once legal forms such as Inc. or GmbH are ignored) and saved in the SEARCH_MATCHES record. Only candidates scoring at least Minimum match score are scraped, and each row says which term and score found it.

minMatchScore.title: Minimum match score
minMatchScore.description: Advertiser names need at least this score to be scraped: 1 means exact name matches only, 0.8 also accepts close spellings. Use advertiserIds when you know the exact advertiser.

maxAdvertisersPerTerm.title: Max advertisers per name
maxAdvertisersPerTerm.description: At most this many matching advertisers are scraped per name, best score first, then the one with the most ads.

region.title: Region
region.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 country code where the ads were shown, for example US or DE, or "anywhere". firstShown, lastShown and daysShown come back for every region.

dateFrom.title: Shown from
dateFrom.description: Only ads shown on or after this date. Defaults to 30 days before Shown until.

dateTo.title: Shown until
dateTo.description: Only ads shown on or before this date. Defaults to today.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: Ad formats to include. Each row carries the format the Transparency Center reports.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Where the ads were shown, using the Transparency Center's own platform filter. Leave all selected for every platform. When some are selected, each row says which platform filter found it.

includeCreativeContent.title: Include creative content
includeCreativeContent.description: Headline, text, image and video URLs and display URL for each ad. Most text ads are published as a single rendered image, which is returned as imageUrls. Read an example.

downloadAssets.title: Download images
downloadAssets.description: Saves up to 3 images per ad to the run's key-value store. Each saved image is a separate paid event. Videos are YouTube links and are not downloaded.

maxAdsPerAdvertiser.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerAdvertiser.description: Enforced exactly per advertiser. Set 0 for no limit.

maxAdsPerDomain.title: Max ads per domain
maxAdsPerDomain.description: Enforced exactly per domain in Website domains, across all its advertisers. Big brands have hundreds of resellers advertising their domain, so this keeps cost predictable. Set 0 for no limit.

onlyNewSince.title: Only ads first shown since
onlyNewSince.description: Monitoring mode: ISO date or date-time. Returns only ads first shown after it, so a scheduled run gives you just the new creatives. Read an example.

canary.title: Drift canary (advanced)
canary.description: For scheduled monitoring runs. Example: {"baselineStore": "canary-baseline", "thresholdPoints": 5}. The first run saves the null rate of key fields (and the mix of a status field) to that named key-value store; later runs compare and fail with an alert if any value moves by more than thresholdPoints percentage points. Leave empty for normal runs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy. Google throttles repeated requests from one IP, so a rotating proxy is needed.
